title: pyRevit extension
description: A pyRevit extension for the pyRevit Extension Builder: tabs, holding panels, holding bundles (buttons, stacks, pulldowns...). Open it in the builder with #spec=<URL-encoded JSON>, or load it as a file there.

name.description: Panel name, shown under its buttons.

title.description: Text under the icon; \n breaks the line. Default: the name.

context.description: Context. When the button is enabled. With none, it always is.

engine_clean.description: Clean Engine. Run in a fresh engine every time instead of a cached one.
